{{Quote|The ''Viscount''. Just commissioned two weeks ago. It must be making a flyby for the approval of the council.''"<br />"''Wow.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] and [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]]|<ref name="VP">''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]''</ref>}}
The '''''Viscount''''' was the lead ship of the [[Viscount-class Star Defender|''Viscount''-class Star Defender]] line produced for the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]<ref name="VP" /> and later the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]].<ref name="TUF" />

==History==
The ''Viscount''{{'s}} design was worked out after the [[Black Fleet Crisis]] when the New Republic military realized the need for more powerful [[Battleship/Legends|dreadnoughts]]. By the time it was finished, [[25 ABY/Legends|twenty-five years after]] the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], so many [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyers]] had been captured by the New Republic, that the government considered halting construction on more ships.<ref name="SOTGSE">[[Starships of the Galaxy (Saga Edition)|''Starships of the Galaxy'', Saga Edition]]</ref>

The ''Viscount'' itself was meant to be a prototype for the design and was built as a battlecruiser at three [[Meter/Legends|kilometers]] in length. The subsequent full-scale vessels were 17 kilometer-long [[dreadnought]]s such as the [[Bounty (warship)|''Bounty'']] and the [[Krakana (Viscount-class)|''Krakana'']].<ref name="TEGTW" />

Prior to the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], it [[Attacks on Imperial holdouts|fought rogue Imperial elements]] while the New Republic consolidated power throughout the galaxy, following the official end of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SOTGSE" /> Being the largest and most powerful of all [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]]-designed warships, the ''Viscount'' and its sister ships were later put to good use during the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] invasion.<ref name="TUF" />

Originally stationed at [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the warship was eventually deployed to [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]], following the reorganization of the New Republic into the Galactic Alliance.

During the [[Defense of Mon Calamari (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Defense of Mon Calamari]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Traest Kre'fey]] deployed the ''Viscount'' as part of a trio of heavy warships that included the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Guardian (Executor-class)|''Guardian'']] and the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] [[Harbinger (Mon Calamari Star Cruiser)|''Harbinger'']]. The long-range weapons on the ''Viscount'' were utilized to sow heavy damage on the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] armada.<ref name="TUF" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Viscount'' first appeared in the [[Del Rey]] novel ''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]'', written by [[R. A. Salvatore]]<ref name="VP" /> and published on [[October 5]]th, [[1999]].<ref name="Amazon">{{SWArchive|url=eu/lit/novel/news19991007.html|text=The New Jedi Order: ''Vector Prime''}}</ref> While the [[2007]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook [[Starships of the Galaxy (Saga Edition)|''Starships of the Galaxy'', Saga Edition]] established a length of seventeen kilometers for the ''Viscount''{{'s}} class,<ref name="SOTGSE" /> [[2012]]'s ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' specified the ''Viscount'' as an anomalous three-kilometer prototype.<ref name="TEGTW" /> [[Paul R. Urquhart]], one of ''Warfare''{{'s}} co-authors, explained this reference as drawing on both [[canon]]ical contradictions and fan debates over the ''Viscount''{{'s}} size, while also reflecting the high degree of variation within [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] classes.<ref name="TEGTWe">{{Tumblr|subdomain=jasonfry|url=post/25364458982/eg-to-warfare-endnotes-pt-12|name=Jason Fry's Dorkery|text=EG to Warfare: Endnotes Pt. 12}}</ref>
